deliverable: Two-layer Montreal park and recreation-asset onboarding package with reproducible reconciliation, complete exception register, map, provenance and operator handoff
acceptance: Every source row has one immutable source-row identity and one output disposition; none silently dropped
No source geometry or source attribute is silently changed; transformations retain source hash and row lineage
Coordinate operations explicitly state source and target CRS and axis order; unknown CRS is refused
Declared park identifier and representative-point geometry are reconciled separately; disagreement remains an exception
Only agreement of a valid declared park reference with a unique geometric park is an administratively-confirmed association; geometric-only associations are explicitly suggestions
Every invalid, unmatched, duplicate or ambiguous row appears in an exception queue
GeoPackage opens through independent SQLite and GDAL readers and contains provenance, reconciliation and exceptions
Published acceptance SQL reconciles row counts, IDs and status totals; map and handoff carry limitations
development_split: First lexicographically sorted non-empty facility borough value; choose after reading schema only and before execution on other boroughs
fresh_split: All other facility borough values; protected from workflow result inspection until source instrument hash is frozen
retained_comparison: Same frozen executable on fresh recipient work; same-information ordinary-library control must be byte-identical; no claimed model causal effect
gym_policy: One bounded authored development failure can motivate a separate correction; record both versions and run fresh adversarial cases after each freeze
use_of_models: Human H and frontier U/E/E+ performance are not measured by this deterministic instrument; economics uses explicit uncertain assumptions
mapping_rule: Exact normalized identifiers; one unique geometric park containing a representative point; no nearest-neighbor automatic reassignment
geometry_rule: Reject invalid/empty geometry into exception queue rather than silent repair
authority: Local research only. No live ENS, customer consent, or municipal approval is implied.
